saetze.title: Practice set 1
saetze.sourcing: The structure (papers, parts, task types and timings) is modelled on public information about the DALF C1 from France Éducation international; the numbers of items, the lengths of texts and the timings differ from the real exam, and every detail of the real exam is to verify against the current official exam guide. All texts, questions and listening scripts here were written by icanspeak French; nothing is copied or closely paraphrased from a DALF C1 paper or sample paper. The DALF C1 is a diploma of the French Ministry of Education, run by France Éducation international, which has no connection with this site. There are no recordings yet, so you read the listening scripts.

scoring.note: The real DALF is marked out of 100 (four papers of 25 points); as far as we could check, you need 50/100 overall and a minimum in each paper (to verify in the current regulations). The 50 % line here applies to the automatically marked papers only; it is our own guide, not an official result.

saetze.title: TCF practice, C1 band: reading, listening, writing, speaking
saetze.sourcing: Practice for the C1 band of the TCF (Test de connaissance du français, tout public and TCF Canada), written from the public task descriptions only. The real TCF is one test whose questions rise in difficulty and are four-option multiple choice; this set trains the same C1 skills with other task types (a gapped text with three options, a talk in six fragments, a lecture with six ideas out of twelve), so it is not a copy of a TCF paper. In the lecture task each of the six sections has one idea, so that it can be marked. Times and word targets are our own. All texts and questions are ours; nothing is copied or closely paraphrased from a France Éducation international paper. France Éducation international runs the TCF and has no connection with this site. No recordings yet: you read the scripts.

scoring.note: The TCF has no pass mark: your results are placed on a scale and matched to a CEFR level, A1 to C2 (to verify: exact scale and cut-offs, which differ between tout public and TCF Canada). Correct answers here are only feedback on these few tasks. They can't be turned into a TCF score or level.
